title: Protocol for evaluating CD8+ T cell-mediated immunity in latently SHIV-infected rhesus macaques with HIV fusion-inhibitory lipopeptide monotherapy
protocol: Thaw and recover PBMCs.
Prepare 15 mL tubes labeled with PBMC IDs.
Transfer 9 mL complete RPMI 1640 medium to 15 mL tubes.
Place cryovials containing cryopreserved PBMCs in a 37°C water bath.
Take cryovials out of the water bath once cells are almost thawed (about 1-2 min) with a small piece of ice remaining.
Transfer 1 mL of cell suspension into 15 mL tubes containing complete RPMI 1640 medium.
Mix the cells by pipetting up and down gently.
Count cells.
Pipette 10 μL of resuspended cells to stain with trypan blue.
Transfer the cells into the wells of a Glasstic Slide 10 with counting grids.
Count and calculate the total PBMCs for each sample.
Centrifuge 15 mL tubes at 400 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove and discard supernatants.
Gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend the cells in the liquid remaining at the bottom of the tubes.
Suspend PBMCs at a concentration of 2 × 10^6/mL in complete RPMI 1640 medium.
Prepare 48-well plates labeled with ‘negative’, ‘SIVmac239 Gag peptide pool’ and ‘positive’ for each sample.
Seed 500 μL (1 × 10^6) of PBMCs into each well of 48-well plates.
Culture cells at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for about 12–16 h.
Remove 50 μl solution from each well.
Add 50 μl of SIVmac239 Gag peptide pool working solution (at a final concentration of 0.25 mg/mL) into each well for the antigen group.
Add 50 μl of complete RPMI 1640 medium per well for the negative control group.
Add 50 μl of cell stimulation cocktail solution (at a final concentration of 1 ×) to each well in the positive control group.
Add 2 μl of brefeldin A solution (at a final concentration of 1 ×) to each well in all experimental groups.
Add 5 μl of BV786 anti-human CD107a antibody per well in all experimental groups.
Mix reagents and cells by pipetting up and down.
Culture the cells at 37°C, in a 5% CO2 incubator for 6 hours.
Add costimulatory antibodies (anti-human CD28 antibody and anti-human CD49d antibody) to the experimental groups as needed.
Block protein transport processes by adding Brefeldin A.
Add GolgiStop to all wells to allow accumulation of intracellular cytokines in the Golgi complex, enhancing staining signals for flow cytometric analysis.
Add anti-CD107a antibody at the start of stimulation.
Incubate samples for six hours following SIVmac239 Gag peptide pool stimulation.
Gently remove the medium from cells in 48-well plates after 12–16 hours of incubation to avoid cell loss.
Transfer cells from 48-well plates into labeled round-bottom polystyrene tubes for negative, SIVmac239 Gag stimulated, and positive samples.
Wash cells with 2 ml PBS.
Centrifuge cells at 350 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Remove and discard supernatants and gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend cells in liquid remaining at the bottom of the tubes.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL PBS.
Add 1 μL Zombie NIR fixable viability kit (BioLegend) for a final concentration of 1:100.
Mix cells by vortexing gently and incubate at 25°C for 20 min in the dark.
Wash cells twice with 2 ml FACS washing buffer.
Centrifuge cells at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove and discard supernatants and gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend cells in liquid remaining at the bottom of the tubes.
Add required volume of FACS washing buffer to a new tube labeled with extracellular staining solution.
Add required volume of BV605 anti-human CD3 antibody and FITC anti-human CD8 antibody to the tube.
Mix extracellular staining solution by vortexing.
Stain extracellular markers.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL extracellular staining solution.
Mix cells by vortexing gently.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Wash cells twice.
Add 2 mL FACS washing buffer.
Centrifuge the cells at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove and discard the supernatants.
Gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend cells in liquid remaining at the bottom of the tubes.
Repeat steps (i-iii).
Add 250 μL of fixation/permeabilization solution to each tube.
Mix cells by vortexing gently.
Incubate at 4°C for 20 min in the dark.
Wash cells twice.
Add 2 mL 1 × Perm/wash buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend cells in liquid remaining at the bottom of the tubes.
Repeat steps (i-iii).
Calculate the total volume of intracellular staining solution needed according to number of samples.
Add required volume of 1 × Perm/wash buffer to a new tube labeled with intracellular staining solution.
Add required volume of Brilliant Stain Buffer Plus to the tube.
Add required volume of BV711 anti-human IFN-γ antibody, BV421 anti-human MIP-1β antibody, PE/cyanine7 anti-human IL-2 antibody and BV650 anti-human TNF-α antibody to the tube.
Mix intracellular staining solution by vortexing.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL intracellular staining solution.
Mix cells by vortexing gently.
Incubate cells at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Wash cells twice.
Add 2 mL of 1 × Perm/wash buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove and discard the supernatants.
Gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend cells in liquid remaining at the bottom of the tubes.
Repeat step (i-iii).
Add 300 μL of 1% paraformaldehyde to each tube.
Mix cells by vortexing gently.
Incubate cells at 4°C for 15–20 min in the dark.
Wash cells twice.
Add 2 mL FACS washing buffer to all tubes.
Centrifuge the cells at 600 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove and discard the supernatants.
Gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend cells in liquid remaining at the bottom of the tubes.
Repeat step (i-iii).
Resuspend cells in 300 μL PBS.
Store the cells at 4°C in the dark.
Remove the supernatant after centrifugation by pressing the mouth of the tube on a paper towel for 1–2 s.
Dissolve one vial of Zombie NIR fixable viability dye in 100 μL DMSO at 25°C.
Dilute the Zombie NIR fixable viability dye at 1:100–1000 in PBS.
Fix samples with 1% paraformaldehyde to inactivate SHIVSF162P3.
Wash cells and resuspend them in PBS without Tris buffer or proteins like BSA before staining with the Zombie NIR fixable viability dye.
Acquire flow cytometry data.
Adjust fluorescence detector voltage and compensation using a blank tube and positive single fluorescence tubes.
Record data from BD Aria II flow cytometer.
Record data from fluorescence-minus-one (FMO) tubes to define gates for the positive cell populations.
Acquire data from experimental cells in labeled tubes.
Analyze data using FlowJo v10.0 software as outlined in the quantification and statistical analysis section.
Mix cells by vortexing the tubes briefly before running on the flow cytometer to ensure accuracy and reproducibility of data.
Deplete CD8+ T cells.
Anesthetize SVC macaques with 10 mg/kg intramuscular ketamine hydrochloride.
Shave nape of the neck with hair clipper.
Lift the skin and inject 10 mg/kg of anti-CD8 alpha [MT807R1] subcutaneously with needle held horizontally.
Inject 5 mg/kg of anti-CD8 alpha [MT807R1] intravenously into SVC monkeys on days 3 and 7 after initial infusion.
Shave hind limb with hair clipper.
Inject slowly into the obvious vein on the hind limb.
Inject anti-CD8alpha [MT807R1] subcutaneously first.
Prepare round-bottom polystyrene tubes marked with the animal codes.
Pipette 50 μL of peripheral blood into the bottom of each tube.
Calculate the total volume of extracellular staining solution needed for the number of samples.
Add required volume of PBS to a new tube labeled with extracellular staining solution.
Add required volume of APC-anti-NHP CD45 antibody, PerCP-anti-human CD3 antibody, and PE-anti-human CD8 antibody to the tube.
Mix extracellular staining solution by vortexing.
Add 50 μL extracellular staining solution to each tube.
Mix cells by vortexing gently and incubate in the dark at 4°C for 30 min.
Add 1 mL of 1 × FACSTM lysing solution to each tube to lyse red blood cells for about 3 min.
Add 1 mL PBS to each tube to stop lysis once liquid becomes clear.
Centrifuge cells at 1100 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove and discard the supernatants from the tubes.
Gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend cells in any liquid remaining at the bottom.
Wash cells twice by adding 2 mL PBS to each tube.
Centrifuge cells at 1100 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove and discard the supernatants from the tubes.
Gently tap the bottom of the tubes to resuspend cells in any liquid remaining at the bottom.
Repeat steps (i-iii).
Add 1 mL of Staining buffer to each tube and resuspend cells.
Label TrucountTM Tubes with animal codes.
Transfer 500 μL of cell suspension into labeled TrucountTM Tubes.
Acquire and analyze data from experimental cells using BD Accuri C6 flow cytometer in time.
Mix peripheral blood fully before pipetting it into the tubes.
Monitor liquid clarity when adding 1 × FACSTM lysing solution to the tubes.
Add PBS immediately if excessive lysis occurs to protect lymphocytes.
Determine incubation times for different lysing solutions based on pilot experiments.
Remove residual solution by pressing the mouth of the tube on a paper towel for 1-2 s after discarding supernatants.
Measure plasma virus RNA.
